sgpack-desc:
Stargate Wiki Extension Pack
• Extnds the parser with trim,userinfo,#recursiv,#tocmod and #in.
• DDInsert: Insert text and pictures with buttons, text or dropdown list. Create JSButton
• NewArticle: Select article template when creating a new article.
• AddWhosOnline: Remove user from WhosOnline when logged out, add entry to personal menu.
• CacheArray: Array function for templates - uses cache for speed.• Sort2: Create sorted lists.
• UserStatistics: Edit counts, page creation counts and first/last edit dates inside running text.
• Slideshow: Cycle through several images with captions in a floating box.
sgpack-image-top-desc: The icon for getting to the top of the site
sgpack-audio-seekbar-desc: Whether inline audio controls show a seek bar
sgpack-userstats-cacheexpiry-desc: How long, in seconds, a page showing user statistics may be served from the parser cache
sgpack-userstats-nouser: user statistics: no user name given
sgpack-userstats-badcount: useredittopten: $1 is neither a number nor all
sgpack-audio-unplayable: Your browser cannot play this audio file
